name: Korea University
summary: Seoul university with mostly Korean-taught degrees; its Division of International Studies runs an all-English bachelor's for international applicants.

ib.text: IB results are an optional document (KU's IB code is 002366), not a set requirement. A holistic document review decides; for International Studies, a TOEFL iBT or IELTS Academic score is mandatory.

apply.via: KU international application site, with documents by post

programmes.name: International Studies (English Track)
programmes.about: An all-English curriculum in the Division of International Studies with five specialisations: International Commerce, International Development and Cooperation, International Peace and Security, Area Studies and Korean Studies.
programmes.ib: The guide marks English proof as mandatory for this major: a TOEFL iBT or IELTS Academic score.
programmes.selectionNote: Holistic review of documents with no fixed quota per major. Spring 2027 guide shown; Fall 2027 dates and guide are announced in March 2027.

notes: Every Fall 2027 date (application, documents, results, registration) is listed as to be announced in March 2027; the Spring 2027 round ran 3 to 31 August 2026.

Other majors open to international applicants are mostly Korean-taught; the guide tells you to check how many courses a department teaches in English before choosing. Global Korean Studies teaches in Korean and English.
Applicants and their parents must all be non-Korean citizens; any Korean citizenship, including dual, makes you ineligible for the international track.
